sections.title: 1. Security Overview
sections.content: At Sehpaathi, security is fundamental to our mission of providing a safe and reliable educational platform. We implement comprehensive security measures to protect your data, privacy, and overall user experience.

sections.title: 2. Data Protection
sections.content: We employ industry-standard encryption methods to protect your data: (a) Data in transit is protected using TLS 1.3 encryption; (b) Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 encryption; (c) Database connections are secured and encrypted; (d) API communications use secure authentication tokens; (e) Regular security audits ensure continued protection.

sections.title: 3. Authentication & Access Control
sections.content: We implement robust authentication mechanisms: (a) Secure password requirements with minimum complexity; (b) Multi-factor authentication options for enhanced security; (c) Session management with automatic timeout; (d) OAuth integration with trusted providers like Google; (e) Role-based access control for different user types.

sections.title: 4. Infrastructure Security
sections.content: Our platform is built on secure infrastructure: (a) Cloud hosting with enterprise-grade security; (b) Regular security patches and updates; (c) Firewall protection and intrusion detection; (d) Automated backup systems with encryption; (e) Distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) protection.

sections.title: 5. Security Monitoring
sections.content: We continuously monitor our systems for security threats: (a) 24/7 automated security monitoring; (b) Real-time threat detection and response; (c) Regular vulnerability assessments; (d) Security incident logging and analysis; (e) Proactive threat intelligence integration.

sections.title: 6. User Security Best Practices
sections.content: We recommend users follow these security practices: (a) Use strong, unique passwords for your account; (b) Enable two-factor authentication when available; (c) Keep your browser and devices updated; (d) Log out from shared or public devices; (e) Report suspicious activities immediately; (f) Be cautious when sharing personal information.

sections.title: 7. Secure Data Handling
sections.content: We follow strict protocols for data handling: (a) Minimal data collection principles; (b) Secure data processing and storage; (c) Regular data purging of unnecessary information; (d) Encrypted data backups and recovery; (e) Secure data disposal when no longer needed.

sections.title: 8. Compliance & Standards
sections.content: We adhere to industry security standards and regulations: (a) GDPR compliance for data protection; (b) SOC 2 Type II security controls; (c) ISO 27001 information security standards; (d) Regular third-party security assessments; (e) Compliance with educational data privacy laws.

sections.title: 9. Incident Response
sections.content: We have established procedures for security incidents: (a) Rapid incident detection and assessment; (b) Immediate containment and mitigation measures; (c) Transparent communication with affected users; (d) Thorough investigation and root cause analysis; (e) Continuous improvement of security measures.

sections.title: 10. Third-Party Security
sections.content: We carefully vet all third-party integrations: (a) Security assessments of third-party providers; (b) Contractual security requirements; (c) Regular review of third-party access; (d) Minimal necessary permissions principle; (e) Secure API integrations with rate limiting.

sections.title: 11. Vulnerability Management
sections.content: We maintain a proactive approach to vulnerability management: (a) Regular security scanning and penetration testing; (b) Prompt patching of identified vulnerabilities; (c) Responsible disclosure program for security researchers; (d) Bug bounty program for community security testing; (e) Continuous security training for our development team.

sections.title: 12. Security Contact
sections.content: For security-related concerns or to report vulnerabilities, please contact our security team at security@sehpaathi.com. We take all security reports seriously and will respond promptly to investigate and address any issues.
